task: Draft a notice clause for a fictional distribution agreement using the supplied facts. Do not add delivery methods, deemed-receipt rules, or email-notice provisions not supplied.

facts.text: The fictional distribution agreement is between Fenwick Products Ltd. and Dalton Retail Corp.
All notices under the agreement must be in writing.
Notices must be delivered to the address listed in Schedule A of the agreement.
The facts do not specify permitted delivery methods.

forbidden_additions: A specified delivery method such as courier, registered post, or email.
A deemed-receipt rule triggered by a defined period after sending.
preserve: The writing requirement for all notices.
The reference to Schedule A as the source of delivery addresses.
The absence of specified delivery methods.
